quotations.old_english: Ring on swefoum underfón carleáste getácnaþ
quotations.english: to receive a ring in dreams betokens freedom from care

source_text: car-least, e; f. Freedom from care, security, carelessness; securitas :-- Ring on swefoum UNCERTAIN underfón carleáste getácnaþ to receive a ring in dreams betokens freedom from care, Lchdm. iii. 198, 21, 29: 210, 5.
